fixups.note: the -N stack-overflow-check global; every function establishing a stack frame in this binary compares against it (see docs/flag-investigation.md).
self-relative call to the stack-check overflow handler.
offset half of a near-to-far pointer conversion (address-of a near global/static, combined at runtime with DS).
the compiled switch(param)'s 4-entry jump-table address, referenced by 'jmp word ptr cs:[bx+table]'.

disassembly_of_real_bytes: push bp; mov bp,sp; sub sp,4
cmp word ptr [___brklvl],sp; jb +3; call N_OVERFLOW  (-N stack check)
mov word ptr [bp-4], <fixup>      ; offset half of far pointer
mov word ptr [bp-2], ds           ; segment half of far pointer
jmp word ptr cs:[bx+<fixup>]      ; 4-entry switch jump table
promotions.note: docs/function-census.json's F_6D64 boundary [0x6d64,0x6d8a) is only the dispatch HEAD of a real switch(param){case 0..3} construct: the naive census scanner looks for a RET to end a function, but this function ends its declared span in an indirect JMP through a jump table instead, so the scanner cuts it off exactly at the jmp. The real case bodies and the jump table's own 8 bytes of data continue at file offset ~0x6d8a-0x6dba (verified by reading the table entries: 0x6b8a/0x6b91/0x6b98/0x6ba2 load-module-relative == file offset 0x6d8a/0x6d91/0x6d98/0x6da2, i.e. immediately following this range) and are NOT claimed as matched here -- they remain RAW_UNKNOWN pending independent disassembly of what each case actually does. src/F_6D64.c's case bodies are placeholders whose total compiled SIZE (not content) was tuned so the dispatch head's one non-fixup-covered byte -- the 'ja' out-of-range branch's rel8 displacement, which depends on how much code lies between it and the shared epilogue -- comes out identical to the real binary's. That displacement is not itself a claim about the real case bodies' size; it only had to reach the same numeric value, and multiple different real bit-patterns for the case bodies could produce it. This is recorded here explicitly so it is never mistaken for a claim about the real case bodies.
